# Introduction

The final project begins this week. Students will transition from individual projects to a team-based real-world agricultural data science project.

# Learning goals

1. Understand the final project scope and expectations

2. Connect with real-world agricultural data and decision-making

3. Establish project teams, roles, and milestones

4. Begin developing a project plan

# Lecture - Final Project Kickoff

Introduction to the final project, project expectations, scope, and deliverables.

# Lab - Farm Visit

Visit a farm to observe agricultural data collection and understand how data are generated and used in practice.

# Discussion - Final Project Planning

Teams discuss their project objectives, roles, data needs, and initial milestones.

# Assignment

Develop an initial final project plan, including the project question, team roles, data needs, and next steps.

# Looking ahead

The following weeks will focus on **developing the final project**, from data acquisition and organization to analysis, modeling, and communication of results.
